rows.en: Module 3: Inter-agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: मोड्युल 3: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Module 3: Inter-agency coordination and assessment

rows.en: Module Learning Objectives
rows.ne: मोड्युलका सिकाइ उद्देश्यहरू
rows.bt: Module learning objectives

rows.en: Describe the role of humanitarian actors in supporting MHPSS coordination
rows.ne: MHPSS समन्वयमा सहयोग गर्न मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूको भूमिका वर्णन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Describe the role of parties involved in humanitarian work in supporting MHPSS coordination.
rows.note: The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय.

rows.en: Explain the importance of MHPSS needs assessment in programme planning
rows.ne: कार्यक्रमको योजना बनाउँदा MHPSS आवश्यकताहरूको लेखाजोखाको महत्त्व स्पष्ट पार्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Explain the importance of assessing MHPSS needs when planning a programme.

rows.en: The Puzzle Story
rows.ne: पजलको कथा
rows.bt: The story of the puzzle

rows.en: What are the risks if we don’t coordinate?
rows.ne: हामीले समन्वय नगरेमा के जोखिमहरू हुन्छन्?
rows.bt: What risks are there if we do not coordinate?
rows.note: The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय.

rows.en: Poor practices
rows.ne: कमजोर अभ्यासहरू
rows.bt: Poor practices

rows.en: Lack of standardization
rows.ne: मानकीकरणको अभाव
rows.bt: Lack of standardization

rows.en: Confusion and conflict
rows.ne: अन्योल र द्वन्द्व
rows.bt: Confusion and conflict

rows.en: Duplication
rows.ne: दोहोरोपन
rows.bt: Duplication
rows.note: The recurring term 'duplication' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: दोहोरोपन.

rows.en: Gaps in services (coverage & type)
rows.ne: सेवामा रहेका कमीहरू (सेवाले समेट्ने दायरा र प्रकार)
rows.bt: Gaps in services (the scope and types covered by services)

rows.en: Inefficient use of resources
rows.ne: स्रोतहरूको अकुशल उपयोग
rows.bt: Inefficient use of resources

rows.en: Poor information sharing
rows.ne: कमजोर सूचना आदानप्रदान
rows.bt: Poor information exchange

rows.en: MHPSS and Inter-agency Coordination
rows.ne: MHPSS र अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय
rows.bt: MHPSS and inter-agency coordination

rows.en: Cross-sectoral nature of MHPSS requires strong inter-agency coordination.
rows.ne: MHPSS को अन्तरक्षेत्रीय प्रकृतिका कारण सुदृढ अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय आवश्यक हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Strong inter-agency coordination is necessary because of the inter-sectoral nature of MHPSS.

rows.en: Strong coordination helps with coverage of full range of MHPSS activities across actors.
rows.ne: विभिन्न सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू मिलेर MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको सम्पूर्ण दायरा समेट्न सुदृढ समन्वयले मद्दत गर्छ।
rows.bt: Strong coordination helps various relevant parties together cover the full range of MHPSS activities.
rows.note: The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय.

rows.en: Poor coordination is associated with inefficient MHPSS responses that can cause harm.
rows.ne: कमजोर समन्वय अकुशल MHPSS प्रतिकार्यसँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ, जसबाट हानि हुन सक्छ।
rows.bt: Poor coordination is associated with an inefficient MHPSS response, which can cause harm.
rows.note: The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय. This is an organizational risk statement, not clinical guidance.

rows.en: Presence of MHPSS TWG would depend on the scale of the response and presence of agencies implementing MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) रहने वा नरहने कुरा प्रतिकार्यको परिमाण र MHPSS गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्ने निकायहरूको उपस्थितिमा निर्भर हुन्छ।
rows.bt: Whether or not there is an MHPSS Technical Working Group (MHPSS TWG) depends on the scale of the response and the presence of agencies implementing MHPSS activities.

rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors

rows.en: Small Group Discussion
rows.ne: सानो समूहमा छलफल
rows.bt: Small-group discussion

rows.en: Review MSP Checklist Activity 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: MSP जाँचसूचीमा रहेको गतिविधि 1.1 ‘क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने’ को समीक्षा गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Review activity 1.1, ‘Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors,’ in the MSP checklist.

rows.en: How can your sector/ organization positively ​ contribute to these core actions?
rows.ne: तपाईंको क्षेत्र/संस्थाले यी मुख्य कार्यहरूमा कसरी सकारात्मक योगदान दिन सक्छ?
rows.bt: How can your sector/organization contribute positively to these key actions?

rows.en: Go through the checklist of core actions and provide some examples about the role that your sector/organization can play.
rows.ne: मुख्य कार्यहरूको जाँचसूची हेर्नुहोस् र तपाईंको क्षेत्र/संस्थाले निर्वाह गर्न सक्ने भूमिकाका केही उदाहरणहरू दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Look at the checklist of key actions and give some examples of roles your sector/organization can carry out.

rows.en: If possible, include examples from your own experience.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएमा, आफ्नै अनुभवका उदाहरणहरू समावेश गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: If possible, include examples from your own experience.

rows.en: 15 min
rows.ne: 15 मिनेट
rows.bt: 15 minutes

rows.en: Using the MSP to support coordination
rows.ne: समन्वयमा सहयोग गर्न MSP को प्रयोग
rows.bt: Use of the MSP to support coordination
rows.note: The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय.

rows.en: Who is respondible for coordination?
rows.ne: समन्वयका लागि को जिम्मेवार छ?
rows.bt: Who is responsible for coordination?
rows.note: The source spelling 'respondible' is interpreted as 'responsible'; the intended wording remains unconfirmed.

rows.en: Coordination is critical and it’s everyone's responsibility.
rows.ne: समन्वय अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छ र यो सबैको जिम्मेवारी हो।
rows.bt: Coordination is extremely important and it is everyone's responsibility.
rows.note: The source has an apparent typographical or concatenation error; wording has been preserved. The supplied sentence is clear; the provisional source-ambiguous flag is not retained. The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय.

rows.en: Activity 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors – guidance on interagency coordination mechanisms
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने – संस्थाहरूबीचको समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूबारे मार्गदर्शन
rows.bt: Activity 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and between sectors – guidance on coordination mechanisms between organizations

rows.en: Activity 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate MHPSS Programs – guidance on role of individual organizations in coordination
rows.ne: गतिविधि 2.1 MHPSS कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, योजना र समन्वय गर्ने – समन्वयमा प्रत्येक संस्थाको भूमिकाबारे मार्गदर्शन
rows.bt: Activity 2.1 Design, plan and coordinate an MHPSS programme – guidance on each organization's role in coordination
rows.note: The supplied activity label is retained. The standalone recurring term 'coordination' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: समन्वय.

rows.en: Making sure our organization is represented in coordination mechanisms
rows.ne: समन्वय संयन्त्रहरूमा हाम्रो संस्थाको प्रतिनिधित्व भएको सुनिश्चित गर्ने
rows.bt: Ensure that our organization is represented in coordination mechanisms

rows.en: Making sure we are complementing the work of other organizations, avoiding duplication, and referring appropriately
rows.ne: हामीले अन्य संस्थाहरूको कामलाई पूरक बनाइरहेका छौँ, दोहोरोपनबाट बचिरहेका छौँ र उपयुक्त रूपमा सम्बन्धित सेवातर्फ पठाइरहेका छौँ भन्ने सुनिश्चित गर्ने
rows.bt: Ensure that we are complementing the work of other organizations, avoiding duplication and referring appropriately to relevant services
rows.note: General coordination safety draft; review pending. 'Referring appropriately' is rendered as ordinary service referral, without introducing a clinical procedure. The recurring term 'duplication' is absent from G-0.3; proposed form: दोहोरोपन.

rows.en: Sharing information about our current or planned MHPSS activities
rows.ne: हाम्रा हाल सञ्चालनमा रहेका वा योजनाबद्ध MHPSS गतिविधिहरूबारे जानकारी आदानप्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: To exchange information about our currently ongoing or planned MHPSS activities.

rows.en: Getting feedback & promoting best practices & standards
rows.ne: पृष्ठपोषण प्राप्त गर्ने तथा उत्कृष्ट अभ्यास र मापदण्डहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने।
rows.bt: To receive feedback and promote best practices and standards.

rows.en: Attending interagency trainings
rows.ne: संस्थाहरूबीचको तालिममा सहभागी हुने।
rows.bt: To participate in training between organizations.

rows.en: Links with the IASC MHPSS Coordination Handbook
rows.ne: IASC को MHPSS समन्वय पुस्तिकासँगको सम्बन्ध
rows.bt: Relationship with the IASC MHPSS coordination handbook
rows.note: Proposed missing standalone glossary entry: MHPSS coordination = MHPSS समन्वय. This is ordinary coordination wording, not a clinical intervention.

rows.en: “[MHPSS Coordination is]…a process of collaboration to improve the quality and accountability of humanitarian response.”
rows.ne: “[MHPSS समन्वय भनेको]…मानवीय प्रतिकार्यको गुणस्तर र जवाफदेहिता सुधार गर्न गरिने सहकार्यको प्रक्रिया हो।”
rows.bt: “[MHPSS coordination is]…a process of collaboration carried out to improve the quality and accountability of humanitarian response.”
rows.note: Proposed missing standalone glossary entry: MHPSS coordination = MHPSS समन्वय.

rows.en: “[Handbook aims to] Establish a consensus-based approach to guiding the work of MHPSS TWGs”
rows.ne: “[पुस्तिकाको उद्देश्य] MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूह (MHPSS TWG) हरूको (MHPSS TWGs) कामलाई दिशा दिन सहमतिमा आधारित दृष्टिकोण स्थापित गर्नु हो।”
rows.bt: “[The purpose of the handbook] is to establish a consensus-based approach to guide the work of MHPSS technical working groups (MHPSS TWG) (MHPSS TWGs).”
rows.note: The supplied singular glossary form is retained verbatim; the source plural acronym MHPSS TWGs is also retained.

rows.en: There is a dedicated handbook on MHPSS coordination, which was also released in 2022 – it’s consistent with the MSP checklist, but goes into more detail on how to coordinate
rows.ne: MHPSS समन्वयका लागि छुट्टै पुस्तिका छ, जुन पनि 2022 मा प्रकाशित भएको थियो। यो MSP जाँचसूचीसँग सुसङ्गत छ, तर समन्वय कसरी गर्ने भन्नेबारे थप विस्तृत जानकारी दिन्छ।
rows.bt: There is a separate handbook for MHPSS coordination, which was also published in 2022. It is consistent with this MSP checklist, but provides more detailed information about how to coordinate.
rows.note: Proposed missing standalone glossary entry: MHPSS coordination = MHPSS समन्वय. This is an explanatory statement, not a checklist item.

rows.en: It has 7 core functions or chapters for inter-agency coordination.
rows.ne: यसमा अन्तरनिकाय समन्वयका लागि 7 मुख्य कार्य वा अध्याय छन्।
rows.bt: It contains 7 main functions or chapters for inter-agency coordination.
rows.note: Proposed missing glossary entry: core functions = मुख्य कार्यहरू. The source wording 'functions or chapters' is retained without treating the two as distinct lists.

rows.en: The MSP can be very helpful in fulfilling these core functions- for example it can help establish links between stakeholders from different sectors to discuss who can contribute to what.
rows.ne: यी मुख्य कार्यहरू पूरा गर्न MSP निकै उपयोगी हुन सक्छ। उदाहरणका लागि, कसले केमा योगदान दिन सक्छ भन्नेबारे छलफल गर्न यसले विभिन्न क्षेत्रका सरोकारवालाहरूबीच सम्बन्ध स्थापित गर्न मद्दत गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP can be very useful in completing these main functions. For example, it can help establish connections among stakeholders from different sectors to discuss who can contribute to what.
rows.note: Proposed missing glossary entry: core functions = मुख्य कार्यहरू.

rows.en: The MSP can also help with advocacy, showing how MHPSS is a cross cutting component and integral to the emergency response.
rows.ne: MHPSS विभिन्न क्षेत्रलाई समेट्ने घटक र आपत्कालीन प्रतिकार्यको अभिन्न अङ्ग हो भन्ने देखाएर MSP ले पैरवीमा पनि मद्दत गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP can also help with advocacy by showing that MHPSS is a component that covers various sectors and an integral part of emergency response.
rows.note: The existing wording reduces 'a cross cutting component' to being 'related to various sectors,' losing the component's cross-sectoral scope. The revision restores that meaning while retaining its integral role in emergency response and the tentative 'can help'.
